director.match: Match each heist film to its director.
director.odd: Three of these heist films were directed by {value}. Which one wasn't?
director.all: Tap all {n} heist films directed by {value}.
director.reverse: Which of these heist films did {value} direct?

rows.label: Heat
rows.hook: pits an LAPD detective against a career thief, famous for a huge downtown street shootout

rows.label: Ocean's Eleven
rows.hook: follows a slick crew of thieves planning to rob a Las Vegas casino owner of a fortune

rows.label: Ocean's 8
rows.hook: sees an all-female crew plan a jewel theft at the annual Met Gala

rows.label: Snatch
rows.hook: follows a hunt for a stolen diamond through the London underworld, with a boxing promoter caught up in it

rows.label: The Town
rows.hook: follows a Boston bank robber who falls for a victim, with a final job planned at a baseball park

rows.label: Ocean's Twelve
rows.description: 2004 American film directed by Steven Soderbergh
rows.hook: sends a crew of thieves across Europe to repay a casino owner, in a sequel to a Las Vegas heist hit

rows.label: Reservoir Dogs
rows.hook: follows jewel thieves in matching black suits using colour code names after a robbery goes badly wrong

rows.label: Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels
rows.hook: follows friends who plot to rob the gang next door after a rigged card game leaves them deep in debt

rows.label: Dog Day Afternoon
rows.hook: dramatizes a real Brooklyn bank robbery turned hostage standoff, with a famous shout of "Attica!"

rows.label: Ocean's Thirteen
rows.hook: has a crew of thieves seek revenge on a casino tycoon by sabotaging his new Las Vegas hotel

rows.label: Now You See Me
rows.hook: follows a team of stage magicians who rob banks during their shows and reward the audience with the cash

rows.label: Hell or High Water
rows.hook: follows two brothers robbing banks to save the family ranch while Texas Rangers close in

rows.label: Inside Man
rows.hook: centers on a clever Wall Street bank robbery that turns into a hostage standoff with a police negotiator

rows.label: Baby Driver
rows.hook: follows a getaway specialist who times his escapes to the songs on his earbuds

rows.label: The Italian Job
rows.hook: follows thieves who plot revenge for a stolen gold shipment, escaping in Mini Coopers

rows.label: The Killing
rows.hook: follows a meticulously timed racetrack robbery told out of order, an early film from a legendary director

rows.label: Ronin
rows.hook: follows ex-spies hired to steal a mysterious briefcase, known for its realistic European car chases

rows.label: Widows
rows.hook: follows four women who plan a robbery to repay a crime boss after their husbands die in a botched getaway

rows.label: Entrapment
rows.hook: pairs a veteran Scottish star with a Welsh actress as an investigator and thief planning a millennium heist

rows.label: Tower Heist
rows.description: 2011 heist comedy film directed by Brett Ratner

rows.label: To Catch a Thief
rows.hook: stars a retired cat burglar clearing his name on the French Riviera alongside a glamorous Hollywood princess
